facts.fact: 城边图书馆里，老学者（深紫袍、满脸皱纹）一见"我"就脱口喊「The human!」惊动全馆读者；他盯住"我"的圆耳朵后自报家门 Acrion，领"我"进里屋，还示意 Darragh 可留在外面等。
facts.anchor: “The human!” He blurted out. All eyes in the library lifted to me. The scholar glanced around at the audience he created and then landed on my rounded ears. “Yes, yes, please come with me. I am most excited to speak with you. I am Acrion.”

facts.fact: Acrion 阴笑着趁 Darragh 跨门槛时把橡木门甩向他；Darragh 出手挡住门板、荡开撞墙——随后并未发作，反而替"我"拉开椅子推凳伺候；"我"没等到 Gabriel 口中那种怪物行径。
facts.anchor: I turned to the doorway and gasped as Acrion, with a sneer, flung the door in Darragh’s face as he was stepping through the threshold. Darragh shot out a hand and stopped the wood from making contact with his head, swinging it open with a thud as it hit the inside wall.

facts.fact: Darragh 两度替"我"出头：先声明她来是查回 Edenalee 的路、不许 Acrion 拿自私的记录浪费她时间；再冷冷警告老头别叫他 youngling——他年近四十、阅历远超对方想象。
facts.anchor: “Also,” Darragh said coolly as he leaned back in his chair, folding his arms, “do not mistake me for a youngling, old man. I am nearing forty and have lived more life than you could imagine.

facts.fact: Acrion 交底：馆藏只查到近两个世纪前来过一名人类——Edenalee 农夫，从森林踉跄走出、记不起当天最后 12 小时；被 seraph 士兵拦下关进城堡牢房，直到国王 Suntik 判定他无威胁。
facts.anchor: Literature states that he arrived, stumbling out of the forest, and couldn’t even recall the last twelve hours of his day. He was a farmer in Edenalee and stated he woke in the forest feeling awful but was able to get his bearings and started walking, looking for help.

facts.fact: "我"问农夫的下文——此人名叫 Psilas、受雇于贵族农场做工直到 15 年后去世，馆藏已查尽；Darragh 追问雇主是哪家，Acrion 怒目眯眼低吼答出「Noble house of Toolock」。
facts.anchor: Acrion glared at him, lowering his brow and squinting his eyes. “The Noble house of Toolock,” he practically growled.

facts.fact: 离开时 Darragh 跟在"我"身后反手把橡木门摔在 Acrion 脸上，门内传出愤怒闷吼（"我"忍笑称报应）；随后他为此举道歉，"我"要求他别叫 my lady、改叫 Rory。
facts.anchor: His eyes tracked me as I walked out of the room, and he followed behind, slamming the door in Acrion’s face. Angry, muffled shouts came from behind the solid oak. A deserving case of karma. I choked back a laugh.

facts.fact: "我"提出去 Psilas 做工的农场查访；Darragh 说即便"我"不提他也打算提，但需时间安排农场员工与 Toolock 贵族的会面，预计两三天后带"我"去。
facts.anchor: It will take me some time to set up a meeting with the farm staff and the Toolock nobles. Once I do, I can take you there. I’d say in two to three days.

facts.fact: "我"打听药剂师：Darragh 说 Tironaill 把药剂师称作 spagyrist、很罕见，他只想到一个且不住城里；后来证实那是 dryad——"我"因初抵时遭 dryad 袭击而打消寻访念头。
facts.anchor: but they are not common. In fact, I can only think of one, and he doesn’t reside in the city.

facts.fact: "我"问能否自己买衣服（身上只有人类纯银币、怕不被收）；Darragh 说凭王室信用随便买；"我"问是不是女王准的，他吐出「Gabriel」，"我"应了一声失望的「哦」。
facts.anchor: He nodded. “You can buy whatever you like on the credit of the crown. I was told to grant you purchases of whatever you want.”
